name: hgi_qdq_lg_v6_ref

job.purpose: Re-kit of the gate-clean QUANT LG port group (BANKS 2, kit hgi_qdq_lg_pg2 at 259.2x43.2) into the H-DIE v6 slot quant_NW*_lg 64.8 x 194.4 with the die-granted pins (36b341b5b: VM ports E, engine side W, 1,110 bits a side at 0.096 um/bit, clk/rst N). Same RTL; registered bank-pair near-tap stage (+2 read/+1 write in the exact bench, 152 vs immutable 168).
